risk_if_not_implemented: Without Automated Incident Response Training Environments, security incidents may not be detected, contained, investigated or communicated in a timely manner, increasing their scope, duration and cost. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), Incident Persistence / Recurrence (R-IR-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to provide role-based security, compliance and resilience-related training: 
(1) Before authorizing access to the system or performing assigned duties; 
(2) When required by system changes; and 
(3) Annually thereafter.
compensating_control_1.justification: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training (SAT-05) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Automated Incident Response Training Environments (IRO-10.2) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Incident Response Training
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to train personnel in their incident response roles and responsibilities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Incident Response Training (IRO-10) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Automated Incident Response Training Environments (IRO-10.2) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats.
